Suppl. List.
 High Court Of Jammu And Kashmir
 At Srinagar

Ia No. 01/2019

entities.text:
High Court Of Jammu And Kashmir
 At Srinagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Fayaz Ahmad Bhat & Anr.
 Vs
 State of Jk & Ors.

Coram:
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ali Mohammad Magrey, Judge.
Appearance:
For the Petitioner(s): Mr. Bhat Fayaz, Advocate.

For the Respondent(s): Mr. Shah Aamir, AAG Petitioners while working as Food Inspectors in the Drugs and Food Control Organization are aggrieved of the creation of the post by the Government in Drug Organization made by the Government vide Government Order No. 638-HME of 2018 dated 26.11.2018.

Petitioners are also aggrieved of the action of the respondents in having them re-designated as Food Safety Officers in tune with the mandate of the application of the Food Safety Standard Act and Rules 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety Standard Act and Rules 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Petitioners have submitted that there are having hardly any chances of their promotions in view of the non- availability of section posts, therefore, seek creation of further posts.
Creation of posts is within the domain the Government to be made in terms of the requirement.
Petitioners cannot claim creation of the post as a matter of right for their further benefit.
Petitioners are entitled to the benefit which are accrued to them in terms of the service recruitment rules.
It is submitted that proposal for change in nomenclature is lying with the Government.

No relief with reference of creation of the post can be granted, however while disposing of the writ petition respondents are directed to consider the proposal of the Commissioner Food Safety made on 17.10.2018 for change in nomenclature in tune with the mandate of the law.
Writ petition is accordingly disposed of along with IA(s).
